resources.string: Guardian only handles DNS. Allowed queries are sent to the DNS server of the current network. Other traffic does not go through Guardian. Guardian cannot block all tracking.
Only the daily total of blocks is saved, kept for 7 days, with no domain names.
Only the most recent 200 DNS queries are kept in memory (the screen shows the latest 10). They are cleared when Guardian stops and are never written to disk.
This deletes only the daily totals stored on this device. Your custom rules and the recent queries in memory are not affected.
